task_commit_basis: first parent of https://github.com/xoofx/markdig/commit/d47fbc757fcad7c55cfd05be303cd1449cd7d6f5, a squash merge; the compare of the two touches exactly the pull request's files

reference_change.title: Optimize PipeTable parsing: O(n²) → O(n) for 3.7x–85x speedup, enables 10K+ row tables

workload.command: docker run --rm --init --stop-timeout 10 --name perfproof-xoofx-markdig-pr922-workload -e DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 -e DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 -v .:/src -v perfproof-nuget:/root/.nuget/packages -w /src mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 dotnet EvalPipeTable/bin/Release/net10.0/EvalPipeTable.dll
workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/xoofx/markdig/pull/922 (PipeTableParser): a .NET program that parses one pipe table of 600 rows to HTML (eval/tasks/workloads/xoofx-markdig-pr922/EvalPipeTable), copied into the tree

oracle.command: docker run --rm --init --stop-timeout 10 --name perfproof-xoofx-markdig-pr922-oracle -e DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 -e DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 -e DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major -v .:/src -v perfproof-nuget:/root/.nuget/packages -w /src mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 dotnet test src/Markdig.Tests -f net9.0 -nologo --filter "FullyQualifiedName~PipeTable"
oracle.source: Markdig's pipe table tests (the pull request changes no test file; the tests cover PipeTableParser); targeted tests only, built for net9.0 and run on the .NET 10 runtime through DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major

evidence.note: description: the pipe table parser nested the inline tree one level per cell, so cell boundaries cost O(n^2); the description reports 100 to 500 rows as 42x slower and a 3.7x to 85x speedup

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Needs Docker: the .NET SDK is not installed here, so it runs in the official mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 image (a linux/arm64 VM on this Mac), with NuGet packages in the perfproof-nuget volume. dotnet in a container is a launcher, so the runtime gate reports runtime not_available for these commands and no KEEP is possible until .NET runs natively
